title: Write phase f integration verification document
description:
Write the phase F verification document summarizing full processor integration and the real-time execution audit results.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.cpp (integrated processBlock and prepareToPlay from f.1)
- tests/ProcessBlockRealtimeTests.cpp (the allocation and denormal audits from f.2)
- CMakeLists.txt (the configure/build/ctest commands used)
- Any existing docs/verification/*.md for the established document format

Implementation requirements:
1. Create docs/verification/phase_f_integration.md.
2. Document the integration: how ShredBoostEngine, OversamplingEngine, and AutoGainBypass are wired into processBlock, buffer allocation in prepareToPlay, the lock-free double-buffered parameter snapshot, ScopedNoDenormals placement, and PDC/oversampling handling on the message thread.
3. Document the real-time audit: what ProcessBlockRealtimeTests.cpp verifies (zero heap allocation during processBlock, denormal flushing) and the exact commands to reproduce.
4. Include a 'Verification Commands' section listing the literal cmake configure, cmake build, and ctest commands.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: The document describes how ShredBoostEngine, OversamplingEngine, and AutoGainBypass are integrated into processBlock
The document describes the zero-heap-allocation and denormal-flushing audits performed by tests/ProcessBlockRealtimeTests.cpp
The document includes a Verification Commands section with the literal cmake and ctest commands
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: choose document section ordering and headings
